main_concerns.concern: Cap is substituting ledger hygiene, check-script success, and lifecycle documentation for concrete implementation designs of the two hardest remaining items: whole-task timeout governance and Chinese-first policy enforcement. The evidence of readiness is almost entirely self-referential metadata.

Zero-tail batch 的三项子任务（prism-timeout-governance / human-facing-chinese-policy / pre-revival-zero-tail-infra-batch）全部只有规划和生命周期包裹，没有任何 diff 存在。redcap check exit 0 和 prism check exit 0 只验证了现有基建的完整性和 live-marker 修复，完全不覆盖新行为。这是典型的「通过检查通过」自欺——用管理状态断言实现状态。

minimum_fixes.minimum_fix: Before implementation begins, Cap must deliver: (1) a one-page timeout budget and fallback policy with realistic provider latency assumptions and whole-task allocation logic; (2) a Chinese-first checker design document that explicitly avoids regex/keyword theater, includes a sampling-based validation plan, and names the surfaces it will cover (docs, reports, hooks, commits); and (3) a direct resolution or escalation of the active Prism concern on the parent zero-tail batch. These must be technical artifacts, not additional tracking metadata.

对 open 的三项子任务至少各产出一个最小可验证 diff（不一定是完整实现，但必须可运行、可检查、可失败）。timeout governance 需要至少一个超时触发路径的集成测试（不要求真实超时，mock 即可）；Chinese policy 需要一个 checker 定义可接受/不可接受的输出语言模式（正则或简单规则即可开始迭代）；zero-tail batch 自身的完成必须意味着它产出行为级验证而非仅管理级验证。然后 redcap check 和 prism check 必须因这个新行为而至少失败过一次然后再通过。
